title: Prompt-Pay Credit Schedule — RideLink Trip Settlements
content:
When a Non-Emergency Medical Transportation trip settlement is made long after the trip could first be settled, the member receives a late-settlement credit on the settled amounts.

**Rule.** A trip settlement carries a late-settlement credit equal to the approved amounts times a credit rate. The credit rate follows the days from the start of the settlement clock — the date the records show the trip could first be settled — to the settlement date: more than the long-late days of 60 earns the long-late credit rate of 2 percent; more than the level's reimbursement payment days but no more than 60 days earns the late credit rate of 1 percent; no more than the payment days earns no credit.

The level's reimbursement payment days are 30 on RideLink Mileage Reimbursement, RideLink Ambulatory Sedan and RideLink Door-to-Door Assist, and 0 on RideLink Transit Pass, RideLink Wheelchair Van and RideLink Stretcher Van. Days are calendar days.

## Day bands, for a level with 30 payment days

| Days from the start of the clock to the settlement date | Credit rate |
|---|---|
| 30 or fewer | None |
| 31 to 60 | 1 percent |
| 61 or more | 2 percent |

## Boundary rows

| Hypothetical days elapsed, 30-day level | Credit rate |
|---|---|
| 30 | None |
| 31 | 1 percent |
| 60 | 1 percent |
| 61 | 2 percent |

On a level with 0 payment days, any settlement one or more days after the clock starts earns at least the 1 percent rate.

*Worked figure, hypothetical:* approved amounts of 400.00 USD settled 45 days after the clock started on a 30-day level earn a 1 percent credit rate, a credit of 4.00 USD on those amounts.
